verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (now LegalZoom Virtual Mail) publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec for its 'Virtual Mail Public API', with a versioned base URL, API-key authentication and forward-compatibility guidance. That is a documented public API a user or agent can drive programmatically. missing for 10: sandbox or test mode, changelog and deprecation policy, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is available as a YAML file for import into tools like Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators.
All endpoints are relative to: https://api.earthclassmail.com/v1
Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use
